<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Androids''' are a sub-race of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Human|Human]] race. A Human becomes one by accepting [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero|Dr. Gero]]'s android conversion in his laboratory. The upgrade is permanent: the Human Super and Legendary forms are gone for good, replaced by the three '''Android forms''', and the racial skill swaps Blood-Fueled Ki for '''Android Core''' and the '''Absorption Barrier'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Becoming an Android == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
Find [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero|Dr. Gero]] in [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero's Lab|Gero's Lab]] (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]]), talk to him and accept his offer. He asks you to confirm, because the process can't be undone.

<!--T:10-->
* By default only '''Humans''' can be converted. Gero turns away other races.
* You '''can't''' take the upgrade while you are fused (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusions|Fusions]]).
* By default Dr. Gero only talks to players with an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''60 or lower'''.
* The conversion puts you straight into '''Android Base''' and gives you the first level of the Android Forms skill.
</translate>

<translate>
== What changes == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* '''It is permanent.''' Once you are an Android you can't revert to a normal Human.
* '''Different transformations.''' You lose access to the Human '''Super forms''' and '''Legendary forms''' and gain the '''Android forms''' line instead. A normal Human has the opposite: Super and Legendary forms, but no Android forms.
* '''Different racial skill.''' Blood-Fueled Ki is replaced by Android Core and Absorption Barrier; Fast Learner and Adrenaline are kept.
* '''Fusions.''' Androids can't use the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusion Dance|Fusion Dance]], but they can fuse with [[Special:MyLanguage/Potara Earrings|Potara Earrings]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Medi-Bug Beetles|Medi-Bug Beetles]]. Android forms are never shared with a fusion partner.
</translate>

<translate>
== Racial skill == <!--T:13-->
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|racialSkills.human}}
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:14--> Part</translate> !! <translate><!--T:15--> What it does</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:16--> '''Android Core'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:17--> Ki attacks cost '''50%''' less Ki with no health cost, and your Ki regeneration is multiplied by '''2''', but your ki attacks deal '''15%''' less damage.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:18--> '''Absorption Barrier'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:19--> Select the racial skill in the '''X''' menu and '''hold G''' to raise a barrier for up to '''10 seconds'''. Ki blasts that hit it deal no damage and restore '''50%''' of their power as Ki; other projectiles are blocked. If the absorbed Ki overflows your max Ki by '''50%''', you enter a '''Ki Surge'''; past '''75%''' the barrier shatters and the excess backfires on you as damage. Cooldown: '''30 seconds''' ('''180 seconds''' if the barrier shatters).</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:20--> '''Fast Learner'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:21--> Your techniques gain '''35%''' more experience.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:22--> '''Adrenaline'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:23--> Dropping to '''25%''' health or below fills you with adrenaline for '''15 seconds''': you take '''30%''' less damage and gain '''+25%''' attack speed and '''+25%''' movement speed. It can trigger again after '''180 seconds''', once your health has risen back above that threshold.</translate>
|}

<translate>
<!--T:24-->
The Ki Surge is explained on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Combat|Combat]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:41-->
''Level'' is the level of the Android Forms skill that unlocks the form. The default Android Forms price list is '''42,000 · 104,000''' TP, but Dr. Gero's upgrade already gives you level 1, so only level 2 (Fused Android) is bought. Each form after Android Base also needs '''25% mastery''' on the previous one. Multipliers are the defaults at 0% mastery and grow up to 1.5 times at 100% mastery. The Android forms have no Ki upkeep; Fused Android makes each attack cost 2.5 times as much stamina.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:42-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:43-->
The Absorption Barrier (<code>androidBarrier…</code> keys, including its size) and the Android Core Ki regeneration multiplier (<code>androidKiRegenMultiplier</code>) are in the <code>human</code> section of <code>racialSkills</code> in <code>general-server.json</code>. Dr. Gero offers the upgrade to any race whose <code>character.json</code> has at least one Android Forms price, so server owners and add-ons can open it to other races.
</translate>
{{See also|General Server Config|Custom Races|Custom Forms}}
